title: Slew-rate token microbenchmark and regression probe for core models
creator: Asha Menon
description: Create a compact, repeatable microbenchmark that measures token throughput under controlled slew-rate profiles (steady flow, ramp, microbursts, and cold-start) for our core served models. The goal is a low-cost CI-friendly probe that exercises the serving runtime's batching, KV cache warm/cold behavior, and kernel selection so regressions in tokens/sec or p95 tail latency are caught early. This harness should be lightweight, deterministic, and output structured metrics suitable for automated detection and dashboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Single CLI/pytest-compatible harness that runs end-to-end against a chosen model variant and emits token/sec and p95 latencies to stdout and Prometheus-metric format
Three predefined slew profiles included: steady (constant arrival), linear ramp (0->target over N seconds), and burst profile (short high-rate windows with idle gaps)
EWMA-based baseline and non-parametric statistical check (Mann-Whitney U) implemented; failing thresholds produce non-zero exit codes for CI gating
Integration with the perf CI pipeline (job: perf/slew-probe) and a Grafana dashboard panel created under 'Perf/Probes/Slew Rate'
Automated weekly regression report email and PagerDuty alert on sustained p95 regression for any core model
Docs: design doc and runbook linked; example PR that demonstrates using the harness for a model rollout
tasks: Design: write spec for slew profiles, metric schema, and failure semantics (Confluence doc)
Implementation: synthetic input generator and arrival scheduler in Go + Python shim for model client
Instrumentation: emit token/sec, p50/p90/p95/p99, batch-size histogram, and cache-warm indicators
Statistics: implement EWMA baseline and Mann-Whitney U test; chosen thresholds configurable per-model
CI: add perf/slew-probe job with matrix for core models and quantized variants
Dashboard: Grafana panel and alert rules; example dashboard link in ticket
Docs & Runbook: how to triage false positives and attach delta artifacts to a Linear regression ticket
